field_changes.old:
Alpha Progression builds you a science-based training plan and tells you exactly which weight and how many reps to aim for on every set. You train, log your sets, and the app adjusts your targets as you get stronger.

It's more than a workout log. The plan generator, per-set recommendations and detailed exercise database give you the structure most logging apps leave out, so you always know what to do next.

CUSTOMIZED MUSCLE BUILDING PLANS
Get a training plan built around your goal, your experience and the days you can train. Pick your training frequency, set the muscle groups you want to focus on, and the app generates a structured strength plan for you. Prefer to build your own? You can create plans from scratch and edit every detail.

PROGRESSION RECOMMENDATIONS
Our algorithm looks at your previous performances and tells you the weight and reps to target on each set, so you apply progressive overload without guessing. Recommendations adapt to how hard your last sessions actually were.

TRACK YOUR WORKOUTS
Log every set with the built-in rep counter and weight and RIR tracker. Add notes to any exercise, review your full history, and use the rest timer to stay on pace between sets.

795 EXERCISES WITH VIDEOS
Browse 795 exercises with video demonstrations so you can perform each one with good form. Every exercise comes with an evaluation of its muscle-building potential and is categorized by target muscle and equipment, which makes building a plan straightforward.

AUTOMATIC WARM-UP SETS
The app adds warm-up sets for you. How many you get depends on the exercise, the reps in your first working set, your experience and the weights you have available. Bigger, heavier lifts get more warm-ups, isolation work gets fewer.

PLATE CALCULATOR
For barbell and plated exercises, the app shows you exactly which plates to load to reach your target weight. If that exact weight isn't possible with your plates, it shows the closest weight below it.

MULTIPLE GYMS
Set up as many gyms as you train in, each with its own equipment and available weights. The active gym decides which exercises you can pick, what the plan generator suggests, and which weights it recommends. Switching between your home setup and a commercial gym takes one tap.

CUSTOM EXERCISES WITH IMAGES
Missing an exercise? Add your own. Use an image from the library, take a new photo, or copy an existing exercise as a starting point. Your custom exercises show up in the database, your workouts and your plans like any other.

PROGRESS AND INSIGHTS
Track how your strength and training volume develop over time with clear graphs. Visualize your workout history and see what's actually working.

PERIODIZATION AND DELOADS
Structure your training in cycles with planned deloads. You can also set up plans where the number of sets and the level of effort (RIR) rise gradually week by week, which keeps progressive overload going over the long run.

PERSONAL RECORDS
Your personal records and milestones are tracked automatically, so you can see your progress add up session after session.

SHARE YOUR PLANS
Send your plans to friends or coaching clients. They can take a copy and adjust it to their own needs.

DATA EXPORT
Export your training data as a .csv file and open it in Excel or similar apps to dig into your numbers yourself.

Questions about the app? Email us at info@alphaprogression.com

field_changes.new:
Alpha Progression tells you exactly what to lift. Every set, every workout. Build your plan in a minute, then follow weight and rep recommendations that adapt to how strong you are today.

Most gym apps only record what you did. Alpha Progression plans what you should do next: a science-based training plan built for your goal, your experience and your equipment, and a progression recommendation for every single set.

App of the Day on the App Store, twice. 4.9 stars from 40,000+ lifters. 25 million workouts logged.

YOUR PLAN, GENERATED
Pick your goal, the days you can train, how long you have and which muscles to prioritize. The plan generator builds a complete plan around the equipment in your gym: split, exercises, sets and rep ranges. Beginners and advanced lifters get fundamentally different plans, because they need different things. Every detail stays editable, or build your own plan from scratch. Need just one session? The workout generator creates a one-off workout whenever you want.

A RECOMMENDATION FOR EVERY SET
Before each set, the app shows the weight and reps to go for, based on your previous workouts and what you have already done today. Recommendations shift from set to set because fatigue is real: set 3 is not set 1. Keep hitting them and they keep climbing. Progressive overload without spreadsheets or guesswork.

LOG FAST, STAY IN THE ZONE
Weight, reps and RIR in two taps, with your notes and your last sets in view. Rest timer as a Live Activity, so the countdown and your next set sit on the lock screen and in the Dynamic Island. Supersets, dropsets, bodyweight, assisted and timed exercises. Works fully offline.

795 EXERCISES, REAL VIDEOS
Every exercise filmed in a real gym with certified trainers. No stock footage, no animations. Setup, execution and cues for each one, plus an exercise evaluation of how well it builds muscle. Filter by muscle, equipment and compound vs isolation. Missing an exercise? Add your own, with a photo from your library or the camera, or copy an existing one as a starting point.

SEE WHAT IMPROVED
After every workout you see every record you beat: weight, reps, volume, estimated 1RM and 10RM, best per muscle group. Charts for strength, volume, sets per muscle, workouts per week, bodyweight and measurements. Streaks and achievements keep you showing up.

AND MORE
Warm-up calculator: warm-up sets are added automatically, scaled to the exercise, your first working set and the weights you have. Plate calculator: exactly which plates to load, or the closest weight below if your plates don't add up. Multiple gyms, each with its own equipment and weights; switch with one tap and your recommendations adjust. Periodization and deloads: ramp sets and effort (RIR) week by week and schedule deloads. Share plans with friends or coaching clients. Export everything as CSV. kg and lb, even mixed. An optional account syncs all your devices. Syncs with Apple Health.

FREE VS PRO
Free: unlimited workout logging, all 795 exercise videos, your own plans, measurements, rest timer, records, achievements, plan sharing and CSV export. No ads. No account required.
Pro: plan generator and workout generator, progression recommendations, charts, multiple gyms, periodization and deloads, plate calculator, warm-up calculator, exercise evaluations and images for custom exercises. 14-day free trial on the yearly plan.

Built by lifters: certified trainers with bodybuilding experience who train with the app every week. Questions? info@alphaprogression.com
